label: PF Backlog 57
title: Backend: licensing/entitlement - signed license keys, tiers, seats, quotas, trials, enforcement
body: Owner requirement: sell the product (backend + frontend dashboard together) under a subscription/licensing model. Backend must own: feature-GROUP -> TIER mapping (G1 Core Orchestration & Portfolio; G2 Discovery & Design; G3 Quality & Compliance; G4 Build/Deploy/Ops; G5 Intake & Work Management; G6 Collaboration & Tenancy; G7 Intelligence (chat/learning/model rec/BYOT); G8 Content & Media; G9 Platform Ops & Licensing (operator-only); G10 Extensibility & API); signed LICENSE KEYS (tier + seats + concurrency/quota + expiry + trial flag; use core/signing.py); TRIAL licenses with a configurable x-day/month expiry set by the platform operator; entitlement ENFORCEMENT (feature flags per tier + capacity/quota limits + seat limits) on every API; provisioning/activation API; suspend/expire/renew. New stores: license/subscription/tenant (owned by ONE module; register in store-registry). Pricing is provisional and operator-configurable. Backend-first: the dashboard portals consume this.
